LadonSourceConstructor.empirical_rate_application {m d : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin d)] (p : Primitives m d) (gamma c : ℝ)
  (hg : 0 < gamma) (hc : 0 < c) (T : ℕ → ℕ) (hT : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < T n) (hlim : Tendsto T atTop atTop) (x : ℕ → Fin d → ℝ)
  (x0 : Fin d → ℝ) (hx : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 x0)) (loss : Fin m → (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ)
  (hdiff : ∀ r ∈ p.dataset, ∀ (z : Fin d → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ (loss r) z)
  (hrecord : ∀ r ∈ p.dataset, ∀ (z : Fin d → ℝ) (i : Fin d), (fderiv ℝ (loss r) z) (coordinateVector i) = p.query z r i)
  (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 fun y => (↑p.dataset.card)⁻¹ * ∑ r ∈ p.dataset, loss r y) (dispersion hessian lower : ℝ)
  (hsmall : dispersion ≤ p.C / 2) (hH : 0 ≤ hessian)
  (hlower : ∀ (z : Fin d → ℝ), lower ≤ (↑p.dataset.card)⁻¹ * ∑ r ∈ p.dataset, loss r z)
  (hdisp : ∀ (z : Fin d → ℝ), (gradientDispersion fun r => p.query z ↑r) ≤ dispersion)
  (hhess :
    ∀ (z v : EuclideanState (Fin d)),
      ((hessianBilinear (fun y => (↑p.dataset.card)⁻¹ * ∑ r ∈ p.dataset, loss r y) z) v) v ≤ hessian * ∑ i, v i ^ 2) :
  have data := sourceData p x x0 gamma c hg hc T hT;
  have gain := zeroResponseCoefficient (data.base.firstPrinciplesAtMesh 0).betaSeparation / p.C;
  ∀ (tolerance : ℝ),
    0 < tolerance →
      ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in atTop,
        ∫ (history : Mf.DP.AdaptiveReleaseHistory (Fin d → ℝ)),
            data.retainedNodeAverage n (fun z => clippedGradientPenalty p.C (meanGradient fun r => p.query z ↑r))
              history ∂(data.family n).transcriptMeasureAtMesh (data.mesh n) ≤
          2 * ((↑p.dataset.card)⁻¹ * ∑ r ∈ p.dataset, loss r x0 - lower) / (gain * data.base.physicalHorizon) +
                dispersion ^ 2 +
              hessian *
                  ((c * √gamma) •
                      DPAdamFixedBetaGaussianResampling.covariance
                        (data.base.firstPrinciplesAtMesh 0).betaSeparation).trace /
                gain +
            tolerance
